panels.title: Выручка по занятиям
panels.description: Сумма цен занятий, не поступления от продажи пакетов.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.price), 0) AS revenue
FROM main.schedule s LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=s.type_train_id
WHERE s.date >= $__timeFrom()::date AND s.date <= $__timeTo()::date
AND COALESCE(s.is_group, false)::text ~ '^(${format:raw})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.rent_debt), 0) AS rent
FROM main.schedule s LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=s.type_train_id
WHERE s.date >= $__timeFrom()::date AND s.date <= $__timeTo()::date
AND COALESCE(s.is_group, false)::text ~ '^(${format:raw})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.price - s.rent_debt), 0) AS gross_profit
FROM main.schedule s LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=s.type_train_id
WHERE s.date >= $__timeFrom()::date AND s.date <= $__timeTo()::date
AND COALESCE(s.is_group, false)::text ~ '^(${format:raw})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(s.price - s.rent_debt) / NULLIF(SUM(s.price), 0) AS margin_pct
FROM main.schedule s LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=s.type_train_id
WHERE s.date >= $__timeFrom()::date AND s.date <= $__timeTo()::date
AND COALESCE(s.is_group, false)::text ~ '^(${format:raw})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'

SELECT s.date::timestamp AS time, COALESCE(SUM(s.price),0) AS revenue, COALESCE(SUM(s.rent_debt),0) AS rent, COALESCE(SUM(s.price-s.rent_debt),0) AS gross_profit
FROM main.schedule s LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=s.type_train_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.date::timestamp) AND COALESCE(s.is_group,false)::text ~ '^(${format:raw})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.date::timestamp AS time, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE(s.is_group,false)) AS personal_sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(s.is_group,false)) AS group_sessions, COALESCE(SUM(p.n) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(s.is_group,false)),0) AS group_participants
FROM main.schedule s LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=s.type_train_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM main.schedule_participant sp WHERE sp.schedule_id=s.id) p ON true
WHERE $__timeFilter(s.date::timestamp) AND COALESCE(s.is_group,false)::text ~ '^(${format:raw})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT COALESCE(t.type_train,s.type_train,'Не задан') AS training_type, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COALESCE(SUM(s.price),0) AS revenue, COALESCE(SUM(s.price-s.rent_debt),0) AS gross_profit
FROM main.schedule s LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=s.type_train_id
WHERE s.date >= $__timeFrom()::date AND s.date <= $__timeTo()::date AND COALESCE(s.is_group,false)::text ~ '^(${format:raw})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT s.date,s.time,CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.is_group,false) THEN 'Групповая' ELSE 'Персональная' END AS format,COALESCE(t.type_train,s.type_train,'Не задан') AS training_type,s.price,CASE WHEN COALESCE(s.is_group,false) THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.schedule_participant sp WHERE sp.schedule_id=s.id) ELSE 1 END AS participants
FROM main.schedule s LEFT JOIN main.trains t ON t.id=s.type_train_id
WHERE s.date >= CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(s.is_group,false)::text ~ '^(${format:raw})$' AND COALESCE(t.location,'ter_fit') ~ '^(${location:raw})$'
ORDER BY s.date,s.time LIMIT 50
